summary: Evotec SE filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 9, 2026, announcing that its subsidiary Just Evotec Biologics initiated a first-in-human Phase 1 trial of JST-018, a monoclonal antibody cocktail targeting orthopoxviruses, developed under the U.S. Department of War's Accelerated Antibodies Program. Clinical trial material was manufactured at the J.POD Redmond, Washington facility using continuous bioprocessing. The program stems from a 2023 contract awarded via the Medical CBRN Defense Consortium; combined announced contract value with an earlier plague program is up to $123.9 million. This is an operational milestone, not a special situation.
